subScenes.name: 确认预订
subScenes.description: 旅客向前台确认预订信息，提供姓名和入住日期。

qaPairs.triggerText: Can I confirm your reservation under the name Smith?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我能确认一下预订姓名是史密斯吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台确认预订姓名

followUps.text: Yes, that's me. I booked a double room for two nights.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，是我订的，我订了双人房，住两晚。

followUps.text: Actually, it's under Johnson—I changed it last week.
followUps.text_cn: 其实预订名是约翰逊，我上周改过。

followUps.text: I'm not sure—I booked through a third-party site. Can you check with my email?
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，我是通过第三方网站订的，能用我的邮箱查一下吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于酒店入住时核对预订姓名，常见于前台接待环节，用户可能因改名、第三方预订或记忆不清而给出不同回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have a reservation with us today?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您今天有在我们酒店预订吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台初步确认是否有预订

followUps.text: Yes, I booked a standard room for tonight under Lee.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，我预订了今晚的标准间，名字是李。

followUps.text: I think so—I got a confirmation email, but I don't have it on me.
followUps.text_cn: 我想有，我收到了确认邮件，但没带在身上。

followUps.text: No, I didn't book—I was hoping to get a room on the spot.
followUps.text_cn: 没有，我没预订，想看看有没有空房。

qaPairs.usageNote: 前台最常问的开场问题，用户可能有预订、无凭证或无预订，三种回应覆盖真实场景中90%以上情况。

qaPairs.triggerText: What time did you plan to check in?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台确认入住时间以便安排房间

followUps.text: I'm arriving at 3 PM—my flight landed on time.
followUps.text_cn: 我三点到，航班准时。

followUps.text: I might be late—my train is delayed. Can I check in after 6?
followUps.text_cn: 我可能会晚点，火车延误了，六点后能入住吗？

followUps.text: I'm here early—can I drop my bags and check in later?
followUps.text_cn: 我到得早，能先寄存行李，稍后再办理入住吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 前台常用于评估房间可用性与安排流程，用户可能准时、延误或提前到达，三种回应体现真实旅行中的时间不确定性。

subScenes.name: 出示证件
subScenes.description: 旅客出示护照，前台核对身份并登记信息。

qaPairs.triggerText: Could I see your passport and a credit card, please?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 请出示您的护照和信用卡好吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台要求出示证件和支付方式

followUps.text: Sure, here's my passport and my Visa card.
followUps.text_cn: 当然，这是我的护照和维萨卡。

followUps.text: I only have my national ID card—can I use that instead?
followUps.text_cn: 我只有身份证，可以用这个吗？

followUps.text: I left my credit card in the room—can I pay later?
followUps.text_cn: 我把信用卡忘在房间了，可以稍后付款吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 酒店入住时前台最常见的证件和支付方式确认语，用户需灵活应对不同证件或支付情况

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you have a reservation under your name?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您有以您姓名预订的房间吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 前台核对预订信息时的常规提问

followUps.text: Yes, under John Smith—booking number A7892.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，名字是John Smith，预订号A7892。

followUps.text: Actually, my friend booked it—can I check in with his name?
followUps.text_cn: 其实是我的朋友订的，我能用他的名字办理入住吗？

followUps.text: I’m not sure—I booked through an app. Can you look it up with my email?
followUps.text_cn: 我不太确定，我是通过App订的，能用我的邮箱查一下吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 入住时前台必问的预订确认问题，用户需能应对本人/他人预订、线上预订等不同情况

qaPairs.triggerText: Is this your only form of identification?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 前台对证件完整性进行二次确认

followUps.text: Yes, just my passport—I don’t have a driver’s license.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，只有护照，我没有驾照。

followUps.text: I also have my national ID card—would you like to see it too?
followUps.text_cn: 我还有身份证，您需要看一下吗？

followUps.text: I lost my ID last week—I’m sorry, can I still check in?
followUps.text_cn: 我上周丢了我的证件，很抱歉，还能办理入住吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 酒店为合规要求常进行证件完整性确认，用户需能应对无证、多证、遗失等真实情境

subScenes.name: 支付押金
subScenes.description: 前台说明押金金额，旅客用信用卡或现金支付。

qaPairs.triggerText: How would you like to pay the deposit?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您想用什么方式支付押金？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店入住时支付押金环节

followUps.text: I'll pay by credit card, please.
followUps.text_cn: 我用信用卡支付。

followUps.text: Do you accept cash? I don't have a card with me.
followUps.text_cn: 你们收现金吗？我没带卡。

followUps.text: Can I use Alipay or WeChat Pay? I only have mobile payment.
followUps.text_cn: 可以用支付宝或微信支付吗？我只有移动支付。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于酒店入住时支付押金的典型对话，覆盖主流支付方式，帮助学习者应对不同支付偏好和限制。

qaPairs.triggerText: The deposit is $100. Is that okay?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台确认押金金额并等待顾客同意

followUps.text: Sure, that's fine.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，没问题。

followUps.text: Is that refundable if there's no damage?
followUps.text_cn: 如果没有损坏，这笔押金会退还吗？

followUps.text: Could we lower it to $50? I'm only staying one night.
followUps.text_cn: 能降到50美元吗？我只住一晚。

qaPairs.usageNote: 顾客面对押金金额确认时的不同反应，涵盖接受、质疑和协商三种典型态度，增强真实应对能力。

qaPairs.triggerText: We need a deposit before we give you the key.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 在给您房卡之前，我们需要先收押金。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台要求支付押金作为入住前提

followUps.text: No problem, I'll pay right away.
followUps.text_cn: 没问题，我现在就付。

followUps.text: Wait, I need to check my balance first.
followUps.text_cn: 等一下，我需要先查一下余额。

followUps.text: Can I pay at the front desk when I check out instead?
followUps.text_cn: 我可以在退房时再付押金吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当押金被设定为入住前提时，顾客可能的反应，涵盖立即响应、犹豫和寻求替代方案，反映真实心理与沟通策略。

subScenes.name: 询问设施
subScenes.description: 旅客询问WiFi密码、早餐时间及房间设施。

qaPairs.triggerText: Is there a gym in the hotel?

followUps.text: Yes, we have a 24-hour fitness center on the 5th floor.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，我们五楼有24小时健身中心。

followUps.text: We don't have a gym, but there's a nearby fitness club we can recommend.
followUps.text_cn: 我们没有健身房，但可以推荐一家附近的健身俱乐部。

followUps.text: The gym is currently under renovation and will reopen next week.
followUps.text_cn: 健身房目前正在翻新，下周重新开放。

qaPairs.usageNote: 客人常询问酒店基础设施，回应需明确状态（开放/关闭/替代）

qaPairs.triggerText: Could you tell me where the business center is?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 服务员询问客人是否需要商务设施

followUps.text: Yes, please. I need to print a document and use a computer.
followUps.text_cn: 是的，请帮我。我需要打印文件并使用电脑。

followUps.text: No, thanks. I'm good with my phone.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我用手机就行。

followUps.text: Do you offer fax services there too?
followUps.text_cn: 那里能传真吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 服务员主动提供商务设施信息，客人回应需体现真实需求差异

qaPairs.triggerText: Is there a pool and is it open now?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 有游泳池吗？现在开放吗？

followUps.text: Yes, the outdoor pool is open from 7 AM to 9 PM daily.
followUps.text_cn: 有的，户外泳池每天早上7点到晚上9点开放。

followUps.text: We only have an indoor heated pool, and it's open until 10 PM.
followUps.text_cn: 我们只有室内恒温泳池，开放到晚上10点。

followUps.text: The pool is closed for maintenance today, but it's open tomorrow.
followUps.text_cn: 泳池今天因维护关闭，明天开放。

qaPairs.usageNote: 客人常同时询问设施存在性与开放状态，回应需区分类型与时间

subScenes.name: 领取房卡
subScenes.description: 前台发放房卡，指引房间位置并致意告别。

qaPairs.triggerText: May I have your name and reservation number, please?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 请问您的姓名和预订编号是多少？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 酒店前台核对信息后准备发放房卡

followUps.text: I'm Sarah Chen, and my reservation number is R78923.
followUps.text_cn: 我是陈莎拉，预订编号是R78923。

followUps.text: I'm not sure about the number—can you check under John Smith? I booked for him.
followUps.text_cn: 我不太记得编号了，能用约翰·史密斯的名字查一下吗？我是替他订的。

followUps.text: I just checked in online—do you still need the number?
followUps.text_cn: 我刚在线办理了入住，还需要预订编号吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 这是入住流程的第一步，用户需准确提供身份信息，回应应简洁清晰，避免冗长解释。

qaPairs.triggerText: Would you like a key card or a traditional key?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 您想要磁卡钥匙还是传统钥匙？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 前台提供两种房卡选择，用户需明确偏好

followUps.text: I'll take the key card, please. It's easier to carry.
followUps.text_cn: 我要磁卡钥匙，方便携带。

followUps.text: Can I have the traditional key? I'm not good with electronic cards.
followUps.text_cn: 能给我传统钥匙吗？我不太会用电子卡。

followUps.text: Either is fine—whatever you recommend.
followUps.text_cn: 都可以，您推荐哪种就给哪种。

qaPairs.usageNote: 此问题常见于中高端酒店，用户应能清晰表达偏好，避免沉默或含糊回应。

qaPairs.triggerText: Do you need help taking your luggage to the room?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 需要我帮您把行李送到房间吗？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 发放房卡时，服务员主动提供行李协助服务

followUps.text: Yes, please. I have a big suitcase.
followUps.text_cn: 好的，谢谢，我有个大行李箱。

followUps.text: No, thanks. I can manage on my own.
followUps.text_cn: 不用了，谢谢，我自己可以。

followUps.text: Could you just bring it to the elevator? I'll take it from there.
followUps.text_cn: 能送到电梯口就行，我从那儿自己拿上去。

qaPairs.usageNote: 此服务请求是酒店标准流程，用户应能礼貌接受或婉拒，体现社交得体性。
